title: Depth-layered cloud parallax on scroll (slow, sleek, bidirectional, motion-safe)
description:
Clouds are static today (~51 .cloud.cloud-N divs in index.html, background-image + z-index in css/clouds.css; NO cloud JS). Add depth-layered parallax driven by scroll so ascent feels dynamic. Plan: docs/cloud-parallax-plan.md.

DECISIONS: bidirectional parallax (drifts with scroll both directions); scroll-only (no idle drift); slow (clouds lag scroll); prefers-reduced-motion disables it.

APPROACH (vanilla): new js/cloudsParallax-script.js (loaded after js/scene.js), passive scroll listener -> single requestAnimationFrame loop (mirror js/script.js onScroll), per cloud transform: translate3d(-50%, offsetY, 0) preserving -50% centering (never animate top). offsetY=(REFERENCE_SCROLL - pageYOffset)*factor; factor derived from cloud z-index (closer=faster) scaled by PARALLAX_MAX~0.15; rAF lerp toward target for sleek trailing easing. Add will-change:transform to .cloud in css/clouds.css. Centralize tunables at top of file.

TDD (tests/cloud-parallax.spec.ts, RED first; helper cloudTy=(p,sel)=>p.locator(sel).evaluate(el=>new DOMMatrixReadOnly(getComputedStyle(el).transform).m42); drive scroll via page.evaluate(y=>window.scrollTo(0,y)) + nudge + settle):
1. shifts on scroll: cloud m42 differs between two scroll positions (fails now: constant).
2. bidirectional: scroll up then down returns offset toward origin / sign reverses (fails now).
3. layered: two clouds of different depth move different amounts over same scroll delta (fails now: both 0).
4. slow/subtle: 0 < |delta offset| < |scroll delta| (clouds lag scroll) (fails now).
5. reduced-motion guard: emulateMedia reducedMotion reduce -> m42 unchanged across scroll (must stay green).
6. smoke stays green (no new console/page errors).

GREEN: implement script + <script> tag + will-change minimally. REFACTOR: extract z-index->factor helper. Gate: cloud-parallax.spec + smoke green x3 browsers --retries=0; close-bead Gate4 screenshot of clouds at two scroll positions (evidence/).

OUT OF SCOPE: idle drift, redesigning cloud art/positions, 0x0 invisible clouds, broken cloudsv8.png/imagedelivery assets (already tolerated by smoke KNOWN_ERROR_PATTERNS).
close_reason: Done. PR #73 (https://github.com/feraranas/how-tall-is-mount-everest/pull/73), base release. Playwright suite green x3 browsers (36 passed); parallax spec stable x3 repeat-each (45/45); PR MERGEABLE/CLEAN; verified at runtime: near cloud (z150) drifts ~2900px vs far cloud (z7) ~140px over a 20000px scroll, bidirectional, artifact evidence/cloud-parallax-offsets.json.

title: Flaky firefox smoke: 'REAL scrolling moves the viewport' wheel-up intermittently no-ops
description: tests/smoke.spec.ts:88 'REAL scrolling moves the viewport (wheel + keyboard)' is flaky under headless firefox: page.mouse.wheel(0,-4000) intermittently does NOT change window.pageYOffset (received==startY, e.g. 49280==49280), so 'expect(afterWheel).toBeLessThan(startY)' fails ~1 in 3 runs. Passes on retry (confirmed: 1 flaky / 2 passed with --retries=2 --repeat-each=3). Pre-existing on release; unrelated to package.json/script changes. Likely a headless-firefox wheel-event timing issue. Fix options: poll for the scroll delta (expect.poll on window.pageYOffset) instead of a single settle()+read; or drive scroll via page.evaluate(window.scrollBy)/keyboard only for firefox; or set retries>0 in playwright.config for local. Gate: tests/smoke.spec.ts green x3 browsers without --retries.
close_reason: Done. PR #68 (https://github.com/feraranas/how-tall-is-mount-everest/pull/68), base release. Root cause: settle() waited only 2 animation frames while headless firefox intermittently delays/drops a single discrete mouse.wheel(), racing the fire-once-read-once pattern. Fix: expect.poll re-issuing the wheel/PageUp until pageYOffset moves (bounded 5s). PR MERGEABLE/CLEAN; verified at runtime: firefox-only --repeat-each=15 --retries=0 = 15 passed 0 flaky, and full suite x3 browsers --retries=0 = 15 passed.

title: Fix buggy mountain hover info-panel (stuck panels, broken debounce) — CSS-first
description:
The mountain .fa-info hover panel (.mountain-info) is buggy. Root causes in js/mountainsData-script.js: (1) dead debounce — debouncedShow(e) returns debounce(showInfo(e),100), calling showInfo immediately and discarding the wrapper, so no debounce runs; (2) stuck-panel race — showInfo adds .show-info via setTimeout(100) while hideInfo removes it synchronously with no cancel, so leaving the icon within 100ms leaves the panel stuck open; (3) e.srcElement is deprecated/non-standard with no null guards; (4) hover is bound only to the 20x18px icon, so moving the cursor into the panel (a sibling ~19px below) fires the icon mouseleave and the panel vanishes.

DECISION: CSS-first — delete the broken JS. Plan: docs/info-panel-improvement-plan.md.

TDD (tests/info-panel.spec.ts, write RED first; assert COMPUTED opacity, since Playwright toBeVisible treats opacity:0 as visible):
1. hovering the icon opens the panel (opacity -> '1').
2. moving the cursor into the panel keeps it open (FAILS now).
3. quick enter->leave on the icon does not stick (wait 300ms -> opacity '0') (FAILS now).
4. leaving the panel closes it (opacity '0').

GREEN: drive .mountain-info from :hover over icon OR panel (.mountain-data:hover .mountain-info { opacity:1; visibility:visible; pointer-events:auto }; default hidden+pointer-events:none); close the bottom:-19px dead zone. Delete showInfo/hideInfo/debounce/debouncedShow/debouncedHide/wireInfoTabs + the wireInfoTabs() bootstrap call (keep renderMountains()). Gate: Playwright smoke + new spec green x3 browsers.
close_reason: Done. PR #69 (https://github.com/feraranas/how-tall-is-mount-everest/pull/69), base release. Playwright smoke+info-panel green x3 browsers (33 passed); PR MERGEABLE/CLEAN; verified at runtime: Everest info panel opens on hover and stays open when the cursor moves into it, artifact evidence/info-panel-fix-open.png + evidence/info-panel-fix-into-panel.png.

title: Data-driven mountain system (eliminate the 5-edit gotcha)
description: Section 1. Make mountainsInfo.ts the single source of truth and derive image, vertical position, and z-index instead of hardcoding them across three files.
design:
mountainsInfo.ts: discover SVGs via Vite glob and build a filename->URL lookup; resolve each row asset through it; throw a clear error on a missing asset:
  const svgUrls = import.meta.glob('../../assets/mountains/*.svg', { eager: true, query: '?url', import: 'default' }) as Record<string, string>;
Reshape rows to MountainConfig keyed by asset filename: { asset, name, altitude, location, prominence, range, firstAscent, difficulty }.
Mountains.tsx: remove the MountainID union; export MountainConfig (PascalCase); derive top = SUMMIT_OFFSET + index * MOUNTAIN_SPACING and zIndex = index + 1; pass resolved src/top/zIndex to Mountain.
Mountain.tsx: delete the mountainVariants map; apply position/image via inline style { top: `${top}px`, zIndex, backgroundImage: `url(${src})` }; keep static size and bg-cover classes.
tailwind.config.js: remove the 25 bg-mountain-N entries (keep clouds, grids, floor-to-sky gradients).
acceptance_criteria:
- mountainsInfo.ts discovers SVGs via import.meta.glob and resolves filename->URL, throwing on a missing asset.
- MountainConfig (PascalCase) exported; MountainID union removed.
- mountainVariants map deleted; Mountain.tsx sets top/zIndex/backgroundImage via inline style; size + bg-cover kept.
- The 25 bg-mountain-N entries removed from tailwind.config.js (clouds/grids/floor-to-sky kept).
- All 25 SVGs render at even index-derived spacing (top = SUMMIT_OFFSET + index*MOUNTAIN_SPACING).
- Adding a mountain = drop N-NAME.svg in src/assets/mountains/ + add one data row.

design:

Keep Metronome (z-[99]) outside/above this layer as the interactive UI layer.
